basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the heart of Columbia, SC, I've spent the better part of my life juggling between my passion for movies and my day job as a freelance graphic designer. Cats are my go-to stress relief, and when I'm not busy refining my craft, you'll find me diving deep into the Destiny 2 universe or catching the latest cinematic releases. My nights often bleed into the early mornings, as my creativity peaks when most are fast asleep. In a committed relationship, I find the balance between work and play to be my secret to happiness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Visual Arts and a decade of experience in graphic design, I have developed a keen eye for detail and storytelling. My love for movies has been both a personal and professional pursuit, often analyzing films for both pleasure and skill enhancement. As a self-taught Destiny 2 enthusiast, my knowledge in gaming has been a combination of trial and error and binge-watching YouTube tutorials.
